ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

19. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.

21. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Caring For Energy environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe from and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
